ValidationRule.description: R-VG7: an approved entry is a number somebody has counted, so the hours, the date and the person do not change under it. Move the entry back to Submitted first. A validation rule rather than Apex, so the automation switch does not reach it.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( ISPICKVAL(PRIORVALUE(Status__c), "Approved"), ISPICKVAL(Status__c, "Approved"), OR( ISCHANGED(Hours__c), ISCHANGED(Date_Worked__c), ISCHANGED(Contact__c), ISCHANGED(Account__c) ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: These hours are approved, so the amount, the date and the person cannot be changed. Set Status back to Submitted, make the change, and approve it again.
